svg.text: STAGE 393 · TOPIC 33 FAQ
WebRTC SCTP DataChannel Backpressure & mDNS / TURN SSRF Sanitizer
RFC 8831 Unordered Delta Transcript Split + <=64KB Buffer Cap (P779) & RFC 8828 mDNS + TURN IMDS SSRF Block (P780)
1. WebRTC RFC 8831 DataChannel Backpressure & HoL Guard (P779)
❌ Anti-Pattern: Single Ordered DataChannel Stalls Barge-In Control
• 50/s interim ASR/TTS caption deltas share ordered=true SCTP channel with barge-in
• One lost UDP packet stalls SCTP delivery for 1,250ms & bloats buffer > 1 MB
• Result: Barge-in cancel & tool approval signals freeze behind stale captions
✅ Production Pattern: Dual SCTP Channel Split & <=64KB Shedding (P779)
1. Control vs. Caption Split: Isolate barge_in/tool_commit on dedicated Stream ID 0
2. Partial Reliability Captions: Use ordered=false, maxRetransmits=0 for deltas
3. Backpressure Shedding: Drop interim caption deltas when bufferedAmount > 64KB
4. Sub-15ms Control Delivery: Eliminates 1,250ms SCTP head-of-line stalls
Deterministic Invariant (evaluateWebrtcSctpDataChannelBackpressure...):
maxDataChannelBufferedKb <= 64KB && maxControlHolStallMs <= 25ms
2. RFC 8828 mDNS Sanitizer & TURN IMDS SSRF Block (P780)
❌ Anti-Pattern: Raw RFC 1918 SDP Candidates & Open TURN Relaying
• Server SDP Answer leaks internal K8s pod IP (10.240.x.x) in host candidates
• Attacker sends TURN CreatePermission to 169.254.169.254 or 10.0.0.0/8 subnet
• Result: Internal VPC topology reconnaissance & TURN-relayed cloud SSRF
✅ Production Pattern: SDP Host Scrub + TURN CIDR Block & Quota (P780)
1. SDP Candidate Sanitizer: Strip RFC 1918 host IPs; enforce RFC 8828 .local mDNS
2. TURN Peer Denylist: Block CreatePermission/ChannelBind to 169.254/10/172.16/127
3. Per-Allocation Quota: Clamp TURN relay bitrate to <=128kbps & <=2 allocations
4. Zero Internal Exposure: Blocks 100% of TURN amplification & IMDS SSRF
Deterministic Invariant (evaluateWebrtcMdnsPrivateIpSanitizer...):
exposedPrivateIpCandidates==0 && maxTurnRelayBitrateKbps <= 128kbps
Stage 393 Quantitative Verification & Measurement Provenance (396 Dimensions · 789 Guardrails · 798 Probes · 835 Unit Tests)
• SCTP Backpressure Gate (P779): Eliminates 1,250ms control stalls; mDNS/TURN Gate (P780): Blocks 100% of internal IP leaks & TURN SSRF.
